g.text: EleanorRank5Convo8 begins.
I’ve been thinking. There’s something I need to do.
I’m going to need help.
Always here for you. What’s on your mind?
Can't chat right now, sorry. [End.]
Check boolean EleanorChristopher2
Chat ends.
So. Christopher.
true
Check boolean EleanorChristopher1
false
I’ve been holding on to him for years. So has Arthur. We have a ritual every year in his memory. But not this year. I couldn't face it.
To... make a very long and tragic story very short... Christopher died in a roadside bomb before we were married.
true
It's time I told you about Christopher.
false
I don’t know whether ghosts exist, but they might as well, because I’ve let him become one.
Perhaps I'll tell you the whole story another day. Perhaps I won't.
Arthur's best friend. We were engaged. I thought I was in love with him.
Don’t be so hard on yourself. You were in love with the guy.
I'm telling you all this now because...
Update boolean EleanorChristopher1
Oh mate. I THOUGHT I was. I loved him, but I didn’t even know if I was IN love with him or not.
Update boolean EleanorChristopher2
That sounds awful, doesn’t it? It’s true, though. At the time, it just didn’t seem important. Then he died, and that became what our story was all about.
Everything that I admired about him has just been overshadowed by how he died. I can’t think about him without this knot tightening in my stomach.
It’s not fair. TO HIM. He deserves better than that.
I understand. Totally. I made a choice to remember my parents the way they deserved.
What happened was terrible. There’s no getting around it. But we can’t let that be the only thing we hold on to.
So why do I feel so guilty?
Why do I feel like letting him go is the same thing as throwing him away?
Because you’ve carried him for so long you don’t know how to stop.
Because you're worried no one else would ever be capable of loving you.
Gods. You’re bloody right, you know.
Check boolean EleanorDating

We’re useless at dealing with this, my lot. We bottle everything up. We put a brave face on and whistle in the trenches. It gets us through, just like it got our parents through. But we don’t know how to stop.
Is that it? Am I that shallow?
true
I doubt even Christopher would love me in my current condition.
false
What should I do? How do I let go?
I don't feel I deserve EITHER of you right now
... no. That's not fair. I'm not being fair to him at all, am I?
Check boolean LettieDiasdeMuertos
I think... I want you to have ALL of me. I can't hold back part of myself in a state of endless mourning.
He wouldn't want to stand in the way of my happiness. He was kind.
I actually think Lettie could help.
true
You could write him a letter.
true
false
Talk to Arthur, maybe. He's been going through this grief with you from the start.
true
false
Lettie?
Part of me thinks that's a stupid idea. He won't read it. He's dead. But...
Yes, he has. Maybe that's part of the problem. I know he's upset that I didn't keep up our little ceremony of remembrance this year.
Why her?
... the more I think about it, the less stupid it seems.
I just... have to say goodbye to Christopher MY way this time. Once and for all.
She has a lot of experience. She knows all about commemorating the dead.
Yes. I'll do it. There are things I need to say to him. Things I never said when he was alive. Maybe then he can rest.
To Arthur he'll always be a lost brother, a fallen soldier. That's the mourning he knows and understands. But it's not mine.
I’m sure if you asked her for advice, respectfully, she wouldn’t turn you away.
Thank you for listening, and for the advice.
I can't do it Arthur's way anymore. I think... if I just tell him that, he'll get it.
+20 Chemistry
+10 Chemistry
Yes.
I will never, ever forget this.
Thank you.
It’s time.
Chat ends.
Chat ends.
+20 Chemistry
I think I need to let go of a LOT of things.
Let me talk to her. If she tells me to piss off, then so be it. But at least I’ll have tried, right?
It’s got to be worth a try. Lettie’s not as heartless as people think.
I bet. Living like this, doing what we do every day, we all put up walls. We just forgot to put doors in them.
Thank you for beating your lovely head against my wall.
Chat ends.
